name: Mesh and blade 3D motif
summary: A 3D render of one blade, mesh shell or ring in black, chrome or matte rubber. The frame has no person and no clothes.
how: Model one form with sharp edges or a mesh skin.
Give it a black or chrome material with one cold rim light.
Place it at 40% to 60% of the frame on a black ground.
Add one line of small capital text and no other object.

origin.note: Health Goth group posts share 3D renders of blade and mesh forms with no people.

adoptions.via: Health Goth posts show black 3D forms next to sport labels.
